# Dash Phone Con

> Answer, decline, and hang up your Android phone's calls from an Ubuntu or macOS desktop over WiFi/LAN. One Android app talks the same WebSocket/JSON protocol to two interchangeable desktop clients — no cloud, no account, no telemetry.

Three independent clients share one wire protocol: an Android foreground service (Kotlin) that watches call state, and a Ubuntu tray app (Python/PySide6) or macOS menu bar app (Swift/SwiftUI) that renders the popup and sends ANSWER/REJECT/HANGUP commands back. Source: https://github.com/shrijayan/dash-phonecon

## Docs

- [Overview](https://shrijayan.github.io/dash-phonecon/docs/intro): What it is, what works today, how it works, quick links to get started.
- [Architecture](https://shrijayan.github.io/dash-phonecon/docs/architecture): How the Android app and desktop clients are structured and communicate.
- [Protocol reference](https://shrijayan.github.io/dash-phonecon/docs/protocol): The full WebSocket JSON message format (CALL_RINGING, CALL_ACTIVE, CALL_ENDED, ANSWER, REJECT, HANGUP) shared by every client.
- [Install on Ubuntu](https://shrijayan.github.io/dash-phonecon/docs/ubuntu/install): One-command `.deb` install of the tray app.
- [First-time setup (Ubuntu)](https://shrijayan.github.io/dash-phonecon/docs/ubuntu/first-run): Pairing the Ubuntu app with the Android app on first run.
- [Bluetooth call audio (Ubuntu)](https://shrijayan.github.io/dash-phonecon/docs/ubuntu/bluetooth-audio): Best-effort routing of call audio through the PC's speakers/mic.
- [Development (Ubuntu)](https://shrijayan.github.io/dash-phonecon/docs/ubuntu/development): Building and testing the Python/PySide6 client from source.
- [Install on Android](https://shrijayan.github.io/dash-phonecon/docs/android/install): Getting the companion APK from GitHub Releases.
- [Permissions explained (Android)](https://shrijayan.github.io/dash-phonecon/docs/android/permissions): What each requested Android permission is used for.
- [Development (Android)](https://shrijayan.github.io/dash-phonecon/docs/android/development): Building the Kotlin/Gradle app from source.
- [Install on macOS](https://shrijayan.github.io/dash-phonecon/docs/macos/install): Building the Swift/SwiftUI menu bar app from source.
- [Releases & versioning](https://shrijayan.github.io/dash-phonecon/docs/releases): How the automated semver release pipeline works.
- [Troubleshooting](https://shrijayan.github.io/dash-phonecon/docs/troubleshooting): Fixes for common connection and call-popup problems.
- [FAQ](https://shrijayan.github.io/dash-phonecon/docs/faq): Why call audio can't fully match AirDroid/KDE Connect, and other common questions.

- [Latest release](https://github.com/shrijayan/dash-phonecon/releases/latest): Download the `.deb` or `.apk` directly.
